instruction: Pull over beside the large white SUV ahead on the left.
paraphrases: Stop next to the white SUV on the left.|Park beside the large white SUV ahead.

instruction: Park beside the large white minivan closest to us on the left.
paraphrases: Stop next to the nearest white minivan on the left.|Pull over by the prominent white minivan.

instruction: Pull up behind the large vehicle ahead in the middle of the road.
paraphrases: Stop behind the large central vehicle.|Follow the large vehicle ahead and stop behind it.

instruction: Pass the red car on the right, then stop near the dark car ahead on its left.
paraphrases: Go past the red car on the right and stop by the dark car to its left.|After the red car, pull over near the dark car ahead on the left.

instruction: Pass the large vehicle on the right, then stop near the bus ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the large right-hand vehicle and stop by the bus.|After the large vehicle on the right, pull over near the bus ahead.
What car is in front of us?|Identify the car directly ahead.

instruction: Pull over near the pedestrian on the far left.
paraphrases: Stop beside the pedestrian at the left edge.|Park by the pedestrian on the far left.

instruction: Pass the partially visible vehicle on the far left, then stop near the bus ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the cut-off vehicle on the left and stop by the bus.|After the partly visible left vehicle, pull over near the bus ahead.

instruction: Stop beside the white car on the left—correction, stop near the medium vehicle ahead on the right.
paraphrases: Take the white car on the left—rather, the medium vehicle ahead on the right.|Stop near the medium vehicle on the right, not the left white car.

instruction: Stop beside the large dark car closer to us on the left, not the smaller car farther ahead on the right.
paraphrases: Take the closer dark car on the left, not the smaller right car.|Pull over by the large left car rather than the distant right car.
